name: SANDJEST Cool Club Nurse Tumbler with Straw, 40 oz
seoTitle: Cool Club Nurse Tumbler 40 oz with Straw
metaDescription: A 40 oz Cool Club nurse tumbler with a straw for coffee or water on long shifts. A fun, trendy gift for nurses who like their gear with a bit of attitude.
summary: A 40 oz Cool Club nurse tumbler with a straw, a trendy, playful gift for the nurse who wants her big cup to have some personality.
whyItWorks: Big straw tumblers have become a familiar sight at nurses stations, and part of the appeal is personality. The Cool Club design gives a nurse a playful bit of identity on a cup she carries everywhere, the same way a fun badge reel or printed scrub cap does. It turns an everyday necessity into something that feels a little more like her, and coworkers tend to ask where she found it.

Practically, the 40 oz size covers a lot of a shift with fewer refills, which matters when breaks are short and unpredictable. The straw makes quick sips easy between patients or while charting. It is a solid choice for a birthday, a unit gift swap, or a just because surprise for a friend who just finished a rough stretch of night shifts.
